title: Comparing Decimals  -  Discussion (U-shape)

objectives.label: Use wait time at least 3 times

talia_dominator.opening_line: It's 0.45! Forty-five is way bigger than five, so 0.45 wins. Easy.
talia_dominator.win_line: Wait, 0.5 is the same as 0.50? Oh. So five tenths beats forty-five hundredths.

sam_withdrawn.target_label: Wait, then elicit a place-value idea
sam_withdrawn.opening_line: I don't know... 0.45 has more numbers in it. So maybe it's bigger?
sam_withdrawn.win_line: Oh... if I add a zero it's 0.50. So 0.50 is more than 0.45?

diego_ell.target_label: Wait and revoice tenths versus hundredths
diego_ell.opening_line: I think 0.45, because forty-five. But tenths and hundredths... they are different, no?
diego_ell.win_line: So 0.5 is five tenths. Same like fifty hundredths. And fifty is more than forty-five!

jordan_skeptic.target_label: Revoice, then extend to money or place value
jordan_skeptic.opening_line: This is a trick question. 45 is bigger than 5, so how is 0.45 smaller?
jordan_skeptic.win_line: Oh, it's money. Fifty cents beats forty-five cents. Okay, fine, 0.50 is bigger.

priya_quiet.opening_line: I think it's 0.5? I just didn't want to say it wrong.
priya_quiet.win_line: 0.5 is five tenths. 0.45 is only four tenths and five hundredths. So 0.5.

noah_g5_fractions.target_label: Ask how Noah compared them, then push
noah_g5_fractions.opening_line: 0.45 is bigger. 45 is more than 5. ...Right? Decimals are weird.
noah_g5_fractions.win_line: Oh! If I write 0.5 as 0.50, they're both hundredths. 50 is more than 45. So 0.5 wins!

story_hook: Which is bigger, 0.45 or 0.5? Half the room will say 0.45, and they'll say it out loud.
